response.justification: While the candidate has extensive full-stack and embedded software development experience with C/C++ and strong Linux kernel knowledge, there is no clear evidence of direct experience with security features for embedded networking (e.g., MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, or switch chip technologies). Their recent roles focus on web/mobile development, AI infrastructure, and general software engineering, which may not align closely with the embedded security networking domain. Native-level Japanese proficiency is also not indicated.
strengths: Strong C/C++ experience with Linux kernel and embedded systems
Proven track record in software development across multiple languages and domains
Open-source contributions and technical leadership (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
concerns: Lacks demonstrated experience with security technologies like MACsec or IEEE 802.1X
No clear exposure to networking switch operations or chip-vendor SDKs
Japanese language proficiency not verified (required for role)
